A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of the same D2S-VSE study, with matching main text, equations, figures and experiments. The supplementary page included in v1 is absent from the supplied v2; this is a document-content difference, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: Sections 4.3–4.4 report original image-text retrieval experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO and component ablations, supported by Tables 1–5 and Figure 4.

after.justification: V2 retains the original retrieval experiments and ablation results in Sections 4.3–4.4, Tables 1–5 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: The two-stage training framework, LLaVA-generated captions, learnable-token decoder and alignment/distillation objectives remain unchanged. Removing supplementary implementation descriptions and pseudocode does not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Flickr30K and MS-COCO, generated dense captions for training, and bidirectional retrieval under the same test scenarios. Removing the supplementary corpus summary does not remove dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same comparators within each backbone setting, including VSE++, SCAN, SGR, CHAN, LAPS and AVSE, alongside the unchanged region-feature comparisons.

E3.justification: The shared experiments retain their dataset splits, recall metrics, backbone configurations and ablation settings. Supplementary training settings disappear without an explicit replacement protocol; this is reduced documentation rather than an established experimental change.

E4.justification: The training-stage, distillation-loss, token-position and decoder sensitivity analyses remain unchanged in Section 4.4, Tables 3–5 and Figures 4–5. The removed Table 6 supplies descriptive corpus statistics rather than an additional diagnostic experiment.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The retained experiments use the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: V2 removes Table 6's corpus statistics, including original/generated tokens per text of 13.41/173.24 for Flickr30K and 11.30/174.34 for MS-COCO. All retrieval and ablation values in Tables 1–5 and Figure 4 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Section 3, including Equations 1–6, are unchanged. The removed supplement contains implementation information, not additional theoretical results or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about increasing embedding information capacity through dense-text pretraining and distillation, and achieving superior retrieval performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the dense–sparse text gap, distillation benefits, token placement and decoder depth are unchanged. No substantive limitation, failure condition or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: V2 omits Section 6 and Algorithm 1, removing substantial reproducibility information: training-only caption generation, the MLP before GPO, weight decay of 1e-4, margin 0.2, Swin batch size 96 and first-epoch all-negative warm-up. A project-page link is added, but its contents are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 41 bibliography entries are retained. Changes to citation back-reference pages do not alter the cited works or research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 shortens the affiliations, adds a corresponding-author designation and project link, and omits the supplementary section. The main narrative, terminology and section order otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The supplementary Table 6 and Algorithm 1 disappear. Front-page formatting, visible page numbers and some text flow change, while Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–5 retain their designs and content.

improvement.justification: V2 preserves the scientific method and main experimental evidence but loses useful corpus statistics and specific training instructions, reducing reproducibility and completeness. Section 4.2 still directs readers to the absent supplement. The added project link provides an access pointer without establishing that the missing information is restored. The unchanged scientific core limits the overall decline.
